entities.summary: Aida Rostami was a 36-year-old Iranian physician who was allegedly kidnapped, fatally beaten, and killed by security forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran for treating protesters who were injured during the Mahsa Amini protests. In light of rising demands and threats on Iranian hospitals and medics to assist security forces in the middle of the protests, Aida Rostami has emerged as an inspirational figure among medics associated with the Mahsa Amini protests. Aida Rostami was a physicians & medical pioneers from Iran (1986–2022-12-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Aida Rostami's courageous actions in treating injured protesters during the Mahsa Amini protests have inspired medics and contributed to a shift in how security forces engage with medical professionals. Her case has raised awareness about the risks faced by healthcare workers in Iran.
